metadata.datasource: EXPERIMENTAL APPROXIMATION, not a measured CineStill spectral profile. Modified by SpektraFilm contributors on 2026-10-11. Sensitivity, Hanatos adaptation and masked dye spectra are inherited from Andrea Volpato's kodak_vision3_500t profile (CC BY-SA 4.0). RGB sensitometry digitized from https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0339/5113/files/cs41curves_600x600.png?v=1712783069, published in https://cinestillfilm.com/blogs/news/what-makes-800t-the-original-and-only-true-800-speed-tungsten-balanced-film-for-still-photography. Chart labels: 800T; Cs41; 3200 K tungsten; 1/50 s; DlogH reference -1.535. The chart does not specify densitometer status, batch, development time or temperature. Status M is an explicit fitting assumption. Status M response data: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JanLohse/spectral_film_lut/6307a98f3cf4f2d7b6d09bab82fbf6f64356ccfe/src/spectral_film_lut/densiometry.py (Jan Lohse, MIT). Fit uses spectral transmittance integration with the inherited dye spectra and a smooth fitted base correction; raw RGB densities are not CMY dye amounts. Three normal-CDF components are mathematical fits, not measured emulsion sublayers. High exposures outside the published range are model extrapolations. No absolute ISO calibration is claimed. The reference log exposure maps to the existing profile midgray convention. Halation uses the existing still/no-antihalation heuristic; no CineStill PSF or grain measurements are supplied. The new profile is intended for fixed-workflow comparisons with grain disabled. Original manufacturer data remain the property of their respective holders.
